details: Leading the Research & Development (R&D) team at Tricog Health. Pioneering healthcare AI diagnostic architectures, agentic SDLC pipelines, automated clinical workflows, medical device telemetry, and high-performance diagnostic visualization platforms.

Wireframed, designed, architected, and shipped enterprise SaaS products from 0 to 1. Built custom data-visualization pipelines, dynamic theme engines, complex analytics dashboards, reusable component architectures, and managed technical hiring.

Designed and engineered a customizable multi-tenant web platform in Abu Dhabi connecting businesses and consumers. Engineered modular Vue.js interfaces, RESTful microservices, and high-throughput data processing workflows.

Core contributor in the Architect Team focused on R&D for financial data engines. Developed high-complexity AST/data parsing engines and interactive graph visualizers using C#, .NET, Angular, and Cytoscape.

Spearheaded statewide student innovation and developer community initiatives. Orchestrated Idea Fest 2019 (1800+ teams, 30+ funded ventures), Inspire 2019 (10 campuses, 500+ students), Think Camp design thinking bootcamps, and Maker Fest.
Founded and led the DSC campus chapter. Organized peer-to-peer technical bootcamps in Machine Learning (MLCC with Google), Android development, Google Cloud Platform, and open-source contributions.
